body:
On distributed grids, `SplitExplicitSolver` extends the sea-ice velocity grid's halos to `2 substeps + 3` and copies the external velocities onto it (`extended_external_variable`). The ocean surface velocity reaches it as a `k = Nz` view of the three-dimensional ocean velocity. The copy dropped the view's `indices`, so it became a **full three-dimensional field on the extended grid**, with three-dimensional halo-communication buffers 123 rows (60 substeps) to 243 rows (120 substeps) deep. The extended immersed grid also rebuilt its own three-dimensional active-cells map, which the two-dimensional sea-ice fields don't need.

This PR:
- keeps the source's `indices` in `extended_external_variable`, so the copy is a two-dimensional slab. The kernels already read it at `kᴺ`, so results are unchanged;
- builds the halo-extended `ImmersedBoundaryGrid` with `active_cells_map = false` (new `extended_sea_ice_grid`).

**Memory** (global tripolar ocean–sea ice model on H100s, `GridFittedBottom` with an active-cells map, NCCL y-partition, 60 mEVP substeps, Float64), measured by walking every `CuArray` reachable from the model:

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| 1/4° (1440 × 680 × 70), 2 ranks: device memory per GPU after construction | 20.2 GiB | 16.9 GiB |
| arrays reachable from the model | 15.62 GiB | 13.79 GiB |
| of which: 3-D extended `uₑ`, `vₑ` (1454 × 586 × 80 each) | 1.04 GiB | 0 |
| 3-D 123-row halo buffers of `uₑ`, `vₑ` | 0.44 GiB | 0 |
| active-cells maps of the two extended sea-ice grids | 0.40 GiB | 0 |

The waste scales with `Nx × (2 substeps + 3) × Nz`. At 1/12° on 4 ranks (4320 × 510 rows × 70) it is about 7 GB per GPU at 60 substeps and about 11 GB at 120, plus ~4 GB for the maps in Float64. With the fix, a 1/12° Float32 model on 2 × H100 (4320 × 1020 × 70 per rank, 120 substeps, the same per-GPU size as 1/24° on 8 GPUs) peaks at 56.6 GiB per GPU.

**Test:** `test/test_extended_halo_copies.jl` (new `TEST_GROUP = "extended_halo"`) checks that the extended grid keeps the requested halo and has no active-cells map, and that the extended copy of a `k = Nz` view is a single-level slab of `(Nx + 2Hx) × (Ny + 2Hy)` that matches the source and refreshes from it. Run locally on CPU: `extended_halo` 8/8, `quality_assurance` (Aqua + ExplicitImports) passed, `distributed` (2 × 2 ranks) 2/2.

title: Keep EVP-extended copies of external fields two-dimensional, and skip the active-cells map on the extended grid
